npcRecipes.sayText:
Solomon Dark...
infernal portal...
RUN FOR YOUR LIFE!

Thank the orb the college sent help!
It's Solomon Dark... we managed to ambush him... we were winning...
Then he opened five portals into the deep inferno! What kind of person does that?
We need to get in there and close them, before it's too late! Follow me!

itemRecipes.description: A dull trinket, carved with a few beneficial runes
